leaderboard.description: A leaderboard of chat activity in this server. Earn XP by taking part in conversations and watch your level grow.

faq.earningAnswer: An eligible message in a server channel earns a random 15–25 XP. You can earn XP once every 60 seconds across this server, so sending more messages during that minute gives no extra XP.
faq.levelsAnswer: Your level is a milestone for the XP you have earned here. Level 1 takes 100 XP, then reaching level 2 takes another 155 XP. Each next level needs more XP: 5 × level² + 50 × level + 100, using your current level.
faq.rankingAnswer: Members are ranked by total XP, highest first. If two members have the same XP, the member who joined the server earlier appears first. This reflects chat activity over time.
faq.scopeAnswer: XP is separate for each server. Direct messages, reactions, and time spent in voice do not earn XP. Server admins can pause leveling; existing XP is kept while new awards stop.

leaderboard.empty: No one has earned XP in this server yet. Send a message to get things started!
